fields.Mg: 6 significant figures; null when state is unknown
fields.coverage: complete | incomplete (some source raster cells NaN) | none (all source raster cells NaN: unknown)
fields.has_mapped_organic_soil: true when the unrounded mapped organic-soil area is above 0
fields.incomplete_source_footprint_km2: overlap area of source raster cells flagged NaN (any organic-soil source area lacking emissions); a raster footprint, not the measured organic-soil area lacking estimates
fields.organic_km2: mapped organic-soil area (extent percent x overlap area), 6 significant figures
fields.state: positive | zero (assigned 0 by the model, summed over available raster cells) | unknown

fixture.note: Preview fixture: a subset of the full table, records unchanged. A cell listed in subset_cells but absent from cells has no mapped organic soil (sparse rule). A cell NOT in subset_cells is not in this fixture: unknown, never "no organic soil".

meta.licence: CC BY 4.0 (data); see license_and_attribution.md in the record
meta.masks: drained and burned NaN masks verified identical in every period
meta.method: Exact equal-area overlap of each 1 km source cell (CEA lat_ts=30, 1000 m) with each 4-degree cell, treating each source cell total as uniform within it; no second percentage multiplication, no second annualisation.
meta.product: Global organic soil disturbance and greenhouse gas emissions, 2001 to 2024: model outputs (Glen et al. 2026)
meta.rounding: Stored values: 6 significant figures; states decided before rounding. Display rounding belongs to the page.
meta.source_checked: see the version-check record in the assessment notes; never relabel an old check as current
meta.sparse_rule: A g4 cell is listed when it has mapped organic soil, any positive value, or any incomplete source footprint in any period. A cell in the 45 x 90 domain that is not listed has no mapped organic soil, exactly zero for both components in every period, and complete coverage. A missing table, period or malformed record is unavailable, never zero.

units.Mg: Mg CO2e per year, period average, summed over the whole 4-degree cell (not per area, not a point value)
